title.zh: 赵子辰 — 科研、写作与生活

description.zh: 认识赵子辰：信息安全专业学生，分享研究、学习笔记与生活见闻。
description.en: Meet Zichen Zhao: information security student, researcher, writer, and curious traveler.

description.zh: 上海交通大学信息安全专业四年级本科生，关注程序分析、人工智能与软件保护。这里也记录我的写作和生活。
description.en: I’m a fourth-year information security student at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, exploring program analysis, AI, and software protection. I also write about what I learn and the life around it.

alt.zh: 坐在书桌前的学生，周围有科研、音乐、旅行与羽毛球元素
alt.en: Student at a desk surrounded by research, music, travel, and badminton motifs

studies.zh: 目前我就读于上海交通大学计算机学院，主修信息安全，辅修经济学。 我对智能体和程序分析有浓厚兴趣，希望能将所学技术应用于实践。
studies.en: I am currently studying at Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), majoring in information security and minoring in economics. I have strong interests in artificial intelligence and program analysis, and I am committed to solving practical problems through technology.

hometown.zh: 我成长于魔都上海，根植于星城长沙。欢迎来火宫殿嗦粉吃辣！
hometown.en: I grew up in Shanghai, the biggest and most modern city in China. My family is originally from Hunan Province. Welcome to visit Hunan and taste its delicious food!

hobbies.zh: 课余时间，我喜欢音乐、旅行、打羽毛球。 我的兴趣爱好可以让我放松身心、享受生活。期待遇见同样热爱的你！
hobbies.en: In my spare time, I enjoy music, traveling, and badminton. I believe that continuous learning and knowledge sharing make us better.

degree.zh: 工学学士 - 信息安全

courses.zh: 主修课程：算法设计与分析，数据结构，编译原理，人工智能安全技术，离散数学
courses.en: Main Courses: Design & Analysis of Algorithms, Data Structures, Compiler Principles, Artificial Intelligence Security, Discrete Mathematics, etc.

description.zh: 我将加入清华大学交叉信息研究院，攻读硕士学位。我对这个新的学术旅程感到兴奋，并期待为计算机科学和人工智能领域做出贡献。
description.en: I will join the Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences (IIIS) at Tsinghua University as a graduate student. I am excited to embark on this new academic journey and look forward to contributing to the field of computer science and artificial intelligence.
